rationale_summary: The document frames AI governance primarily as a competitiveness challenge, explicitly noting Japan's lag behind the US and China in research, talent, data, and venture support, and calling for Japan to 'win fierce competition' and 'lead the world.' The industrialization roadmap, sectoral productivity targets, and market acquisition goals further reinforce this frame. Innovation enablement is secondary, as the plan details R&D and social implementation programs. Labor/talent transition appears through extensive workforce development sections.
